about: Whether a reply queued for when a chat's turn ends still waits (afterTurnWaits), by the chat's row and whether it waits for the chat to be idle (untilIdle: its background service refused it while the chat runs something in the background). Read by both front ends' tests: tests/test_pane.py runs Plasma's main.qml functions in node, vscode/test/queue.test.ts the TypeScript one (core/src/shared/model.ts).
